tier.jaymoskingdoms.hearth.desc: The world as it is. Foes are as nature made them, and so is the loot.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.borderlands.desc: Past the last milestone the roads stop being kept. What lives out there has had to grow hardier.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.wildlands.desc: No king's writ runs here. Raiders wear better steel, beasts hit harder, and what they guard is worth more.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.dread.desc: The land remembers the Wither. Everything that hunts you here has survived worse than you.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.legend.desc: The age of songs. You slew the dragon; now the whole world wants to be the one who slays you.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.effect.none: Foes have no bonuses, and you get no extra rewards.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.effect.luck: You: +%s luck (better chest and fishing loot)
tier.jaymoskingdoms.effect.experience: You: %s more experience from tiered foes
tier.jaymoskingdoms.effect.loot: You: %s chance for each stack of loot to come doubled
tier.jaymoskingdoms.feat.aether_trophy: a trophy brought home from the Aether
tier.jaymoskingdoms.feat.pod_flight: a pod flown out and landed home
tier.jaymoskingdoms.feat.maw_salvage: a part set salvaged from a Maw wreck
tier.jaymoskingdoms.feat.knowledge_withe: Knowledge 5 (the Wither slain, after the four kings)
